findings.message: Write error is now swallowed and nil is returned, so callers see a successful write even though the summary file may be truncated/partial (os.Create already truncated it). This silently loses data and skips f.Sync().
findings.suggestion: Restore returning the wrapped error, e.g. return fmt.Errorf("write summary: %w", err); optionally remove/truncate the partial file on failure.
